inputs.description: OTA target — IP address (192.168.1.xx) or mDNS hostname (ancs-test.local)

tasks.label: ANCS: Unit Tests
tasks.detail: Build and run host-native protocol layer tests (no hardware needed)

tasks.label: ANCS: Validate Config
tasks.detail: Fast schema + codegen check — no C++ compilation

tasks.label: ANCS: Compile
tasks.detail: Full ESPHome compile (C++ + link). First run downloads the ESP-IDF toolchain.

tasks.label: ANCS: Upload — Serial
tasks.detail: Compile (if needed) then flash via USB serial. You will be prompted for the port.

tasks.label: ANCS: Upload — OTA
tasks.detail: Compile (if needed) then flash over Wi-Fi. The device must already be running ESPHome.

tasks.label: ANCS: Monitor — Serial
tasks.detail: Open serial monitor (Ctrl+C to stop). You will be prompted for the port.

tasks.label: Lint: Check all
tasks.detail: Run clang-format, ruff, and yamllint checks (mirrors CI). Does not modify files.
args: echo '--- clang-format ---' && find components/ancs test -name '*.h' -o -name '*.cpp' | grep -v doctest | xargs clang-format --dry-run --Werror && echo 'OK' && echo '--- ruff check ---' && ruff check components/ && echo 'OK' && echo '--- ruff format ---' && ruff format --check components/ && echo 'OK' && echo '--- yamllint ---' && yamllint -c .yamllint.yml .github/workflows/ && echo 'OK' && echo '' && echo 'All lint checks passed.'

tasks.label: Lint: Fix C++ formatting
tasks.detail: Apply clang-format in-place to all component and test C++ files.
args: find components/ancs test -name '*.h' -o -name '*.cpp' | grep -v doctest | xargs clang-format -i && echo 'C++ formatting applied.'

tasks.label: Lint: Fix Python (ruff)
tasks.detail: Apply ruff --fix (imports + style) and ruff format in-place to all codegen Python files.
args: ruff check --fix components/ && ruff format components/ && echo 'Python formatting applied.'

tasks.label: Lint: Fix all
tasks.detail: Apply all auto-fixable linting corrections (clang-format + ruff). Run 'Lint: Check all' after to confirm.

tasks.label: ANCS: Run — Serial (compile + upload + monitor)
tasks.detail: One-shot: compile, flash via USB serial, then stream logs. You will be prompted for the port.

tasks.label: ANCS: Run — OTA (compile + upload + monitor)
tasks.detail: One-shot: compile, flash over Wi-Fi, then stream logs. Device must already be running ESPHome.
